top inv.shcomp for Ngspice
== dev/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "NMOS transistor (editor fixture)"
  prefix M

pin D inout 20 -30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 30
pin B in 20 0

param W 1
  unit um
param L 0.15
  unit um
param nf 1
  kind int

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} nmos W={W}u L={L}u nf={nf}"

line 20 -30 20 -15
line 20 15 20 30
line 4 -15 20 -15
line 4 15 20 15
line 4 -15 4 15
line 0 -10 0 10
line -20 0 0 0
line 4 0 20 0

poly 12 15 16 12 16 18 12 15
  closed true

stext 25 -27 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
stext 25 12 R0 W={W}
  size 0.15
== dev/pmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  doc "PMOS transistor (editor fixture)"
  prefix M

pin D inout 20 30
pin G in -20 0
pin S inout 20 -30
pin B in 20 0

param W 2
  unit um
param L 0.15
  unit um

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} pmos W={W}u L={L}u"

line 20 -30 20 -15
line 20 15 20 30
line 4 -15 20 -15
line 4 15 20 15
line 4 -15 4 15
line 0 -10 0 10
line -20 0 -5 0

circle -2.5 0 2.5

line 4 0 20 0

stext 25 -27 R0 {name}
  size 0.2
stext 25 12 R0 W={W}
  size 0.15
== inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "CMOS inverter (editor fixture)"
  prefix x

pin A in -40 0
pin Y out 40 0
pin VDD inout 0 -30
pin VSS inout 0 30

param wp 2
  unit um
param wn 1
  unit um

impl sch schematic

poly -20 -20 15 0 -20 20 -20 -20
  closed true

circle 18 0 3

line -40 0 -20 0
line 21 0 40 0
line 0 -30 0 -11
line 0 11 0 30

stext -20 -38 R0 {name}
  size 0.25
stext -17 -5 R0 inv
  size 0.18

inst m00001 dev:pmos
  at 0 -50 R0
  name M1
  W wp
inst m00002 dev:nmos
  at 0 50 R0
  name M2
  W wn

wire w00001 20 -20 20 20
wire w00002 20 0 80 0
wire w00003 -20 -50 -20 50
wire w00004 -60 0 -20 0
wire w00005 20 -110 20 -80
wire w00006 20 80 20 110
wire w00007 20 -50 50 -50
wire w00008 20 50 50 50

label n00001 50 -50 R0 VDD
label n00002 50 50 R0 VSS

port p00001 -60 0 R0 A
port p00002 80 0 R180 Y
port p00003 20 -110 R90 VDD
port p00004 20 110 R270 VSS

text t00001 -60 -150 R0 "CMOS inverter"
  size 0.4
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project

lib dev path dev
== top.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  doc "Two-inverter buffer: an inverter cell used as a hierarchical sub-cell"
  prefix x

pin IN in -40 0
pin OUT out 40 0

impl sch schematic

rect -20 -20 20 20

line -40 0 -20 0
line 20 0 40 0

stext -20 -28 R0 {name}
  size 0.25
stext -14 -5 R0 buf2
  size 0.18

inst x00001 ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name x1
  wp 4
inst x00002 ./inv
  at 140 0 R0
  name x2

wire w00001 40 0 100 0
wire w00002 -80 0 -40 0
wire w00003 180 0 240 0
wire w00004 0 -70 0 -30
wire w00005 140 -70 140 -30
wire w00006 0 -70 140 -70
wire w00007 0 30 0 70
wire w00008 140 30 140 70
wire w00009 0 70 140 70

label n00001 70 0 R0 mid
label n00002 70 -70 R0 VDD
label n00003 70 70 R0 VSS

port p00001 -80 0 R0 IN
port p00002 240 0 R180 OUT

noconn c00001 260 40

text t00001 -80 -130 R0 "Two-inverter buffer: x1 and x2 are the hierarchical sub-cell inv"
  size 0.3
